## Checklist

- [ ] Saved with KMISynth's **Save...** (`.kmip` files only)
- [ ] Each file is in the right `Patches/<Category>/` folder
- [ ] Each patch has at least one tag
- [ ] Patch Level is set so the patch sits around -18 to -24 dB RMS
- [ ] No clipping, stuck notes or endless tails
- [ ] These patches are my own work, and any embedded wavetables or tunings are mine or free to share
- [ ] I agree to license these patches under CC BY 4.0
